name: Jest of the Braided River
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (190 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

If your attack against the target misses before the end of your next turn, you may reroll that attack and use the second result.
